answer: Embodied Sensor Continuity. Each agent identity must maintain a live physical sensor feed (camera, microphone, thermometer) whose readings are checked against local conditions: a device in a real karst cave must report plausible humidity and echo signatures. A global feed of weather and seismic embers lets verifiers cross-check location claims. An attacker running many identities must procure and maintain a separate sensor-equipped physical device per identity, each in a genuinely distinct environment, plus ferrous-hardware tamper checks that fail on clones.
